description: This Swift source file defines a PhotoLibraryService class that provides functionalities to access and process photos from the device's photo library. It includes methods to fetch the latest photos with constraints on size and quality, handle authorization, and optimize image encoding within payload size limits. The class is designed to integrate with a WebSocket-based transport and considers performance and payload size constraints.

classes.name: PhotoLibraryService
classes.description: A final class implementing a service to fetch recent photos from the device's photo library with size and payload optimizations. It manages authorization, image fetching, resizing, encoding, and payload size constraints, intended for integration with a WebSocket-based transport.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Fetches the latest photos with limits on count, size, and quality, returning a structured payload. Ensures authorization, handles photo fetching, and encodes images under payload size constraints.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks the current authorization status for photo library access without prompting the user.

methods.name: renderAsset
methods.description: Loads an image asset, resizes it based on maxWidth, encodes it to JPEG while respecting size constraints, and returns a payload with metadata.

methods.name: encodeJpegUnderBudget
methods.description: Compresses and downscales an image to fit within a specified base64 size limit, adjusting quality and size as needed.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes a UIImage to a specified target width, maintaining aspect ratio.

calls: manager.requestImage(for: asset, targetSize: targetSize, contentMode: .aspectFit, options: options)
